name: What are common design trends for modern bathroom renovations?

mainEntity.name: What are common design trends for modern bathroom renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom renovation trends often focus on clean lines, natural materials, and smart technology. Popular choices include large-format tiles, floating vanities, walk-in showers with frameless glass enclosures, and integrated storage solutions. Neutral color palettes, often accented with wood or metallic finishes, create a serene atmosphere. Smart features like motion-sensor lighting, heated floors, and digital shower controls are also frequently requested to enhance comfort and efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern bathroom trends emphasize clean lines, natural materials, walk-in showers, floating vanities, neutral palettes, and smart technology.
